summary: The corrective GREEN at e07f8a94 (evidence bb94a03f) closes all four rejected-GREEN blockers plus the corrective-RED-owned typed malformed-plan obligation with a single-file, signature-verified diff to packages/node/src/v3-live.ts. (a) isControlOperation is now profile-gated (v3-live.ts:3502-3507: returns false unless settlementProfileFor(profileId)==="v1"), so legacy creator-trusted-v1 join/causalJoin remain application-visible through ingress (3910), local issue (6301), recovery control-set accounting (5540/5588/5619/5714/5741/5836), validRebaseRow (6770) and rebaseIntents (6799-6807, join/causalJoin exempted from the reserved-action empty-intent path), while settlement-v1 join/causalJoin/fence remain control-only; all 10 call sites pass the authenticated profile and malformed ABI is still rejected in authenticateV3Ingress before classification. (b) readRebaseOutbox (6952-6958) now skips authorSequence 0 only in cross-object mode; ordinary same-store sequence-0 rows surface (pinned by corrective tests at tests/phase-6b-d110c-0c1f5b0b-node-corrective-red.test.ts:88-101 in both legacy-pending and settlement-published variants), cross-object activation vertices remain excluded (pinned at :103-112), and the activation-digest clause cannot false-match since digest is a required string vs an optional field. (c) The issued/outbox cross-read (5651-5667) now runs unconditionally for every profile, restoring the corruption latch under settlement. (d) The terminal outcome-unknown latch (6423-6445) now precedes the generic issuanceOutcomeUnknown return; nonterminal ambiguity and the admission-halt latch are unchanged. (e) issueAuthorFence (6590-6616) routes the durable plan through copySettlementPlan (issuance-store contract.ts:327-356, pre-existing export since 9fef8d24): exact closed-record key sets, per-entry copies, scope equality, fail-closed undefined, with typed issuance-rejected refusal and halt-on-read-throw semantics intact. Both canonical RED roots are genuinely causal: all 15 failures are assertion/behavior mismatches against byte-identical old production (0b4587fa), no import/export errors; the 9a4b35f4 and 6e542c3d test corrections are shape-preserving (removed a nonexistent publishState field proven absent by diagnostic-values.json; corrected completion to undefined per the fixture contract at rebase-outbox-fixture.ts:1120-1128) and 4543b957/c77f8a1f strengthened rather than weakened the legacy singleton intent pins. Evidence is honest: exact patch sha256 6b56222c reproduced from git, manifest verifies clean, all reporter JSONs match result.json counts, the stale-dist 63/64 and isolated-title failures are retained and labeled invalid gate-order diagnostics followed by rebuild, built-shape proof, replacement 1/1, rebuilt 64/64 shared consumers and detached built-child pass, and normalized Node typecheck output is byte-identical to the untouched parent. No stop-rule contradiction: no retired grammar/global floor/retired-key dictionary, creator-trusted-v1 behavior restored and gated by 26/26 legacy consumers plus 87/87 retained; contiguity, device-local plan authority and anchor fencing untouched; no wire/protobuf/dependency/API/threshold change; no reservation redesign relied upon (the rejected review's refutation of the already-reserved subclaim is respected). Existing f5b0c/f5b ownership (frontier threading/classifier-local terminal suppression, replacement planEffect authority, payload-seeded settlement control-set) is preserved and not reopened.

findings.title: Same-store activation-digest exclusion branch is covered only statically, not by a test
findings.evidence: v3-live.ts:6955 second disjunct (classified.authenticated.digest === registration.displacedSource?.activationVertexDigest) now applies in same-store mode, but every displacedSource literal that sets activationVertexDigest also sets issuanceStore (cross-object mode): tests/fixtures/phase-3g/rebase-outbox-fixture.ts:2193-2200, 2394-2401, 2458-2465; the same-store scenarios (:1034-1038, :1090-1093, :1175-1178) omit activationVertexDigest entirely. If the same-store digest exclusion regressed, no focused/retained test would fail. The clause is mode-independent and statically verified correct (required-string digest can never equal an absent optional field), so this is a coverage gap, not a correctness defect.
findings.required_action: When f5b0c wires authenticated frontier/activation threading, add a same-store displacedSource+activationVertexDigest pin asserting the activation row is excluded while ordinary sequence-0 work surfaces; no change authorized in this slice.
